notes.title: ValeGuard Update #5.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.  I just wanted to announce the small patch that went out today.  I took some time to fix a few Unity related issues as well as some in-game bugs. 
 This update also eases up the "ValeGuard" difficulty level.  I'll be moving back onto new features after Thanksgiving, and I welcome any suggestions or ideas.

- Ryan

P.S:  I've set up streaming on Steam so I'll be playing the game from time to time on the store page or here: ValeGuard Dev Stream

notes.title: ValeGuard - Full Release!
notes.notes:
ValeGuard's full release is today!

1.  I want to say thank you so much to everyone that posted in discussions.  Those comments, as well as reviews, were the major driving force in updates.  I'd love to hear more from you all.  Feel free to email me at LostTowerGames@gmail.com as well.

2.  I'm happy with ValeGuard and excited for more folks to play it in full-release.  That said, I still plan to keep updating it, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Valeguard Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi,

For those of you who don’t know, I’m the only dev on Valeguard, which means I have to choose my updates wisely.  I want to prioritize adding features/fixes that players are asking for when I can.  I also want to thank everyone so much for posting bugs and feedback.  I don't have a dedicated beta group so your feedback has been huge.

Below are some ideas, and a rough change list for the latest patch.  Realistically some of these may shift down to get patches out more quickly.  There will likely be at least one hotfix patch this week.

---------------  New in Update #1  ----------------
